basic_details.short_information: Andhra Pradesh Mahesh Co-operative Urban Bank Ltd., a Multi State Scheduled Co-operative Bank based at Hyderabad (a co-operative bank, not a government department), invites applications for the post of Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) in DGM Cadre. Candidates must be a Graduate/ Post Graduate with at least 15 years of experience at the senior management level in the Banking sector, and not more than 65 years of age. The term is three years at a time, remuneration is commensurate with qualification and experience, and applications must be sent by e-mail to [email protected] or by post on or befor

age_limit.details: The age limit for the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) in DGM Cadre post is not more than 65 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation.

qualification.details: The candidate shall be a Graduate/ Post Graduate. The candidate shall have a good understanding of the Banking industry (Urban Co-operative Bank) and Compliance of RBI regulations and guidelines. The candidate shall have knowledge of regulations, legal requirement, audit & inspection functions, and have sensitivity to Supervisory expectations.

how_to_apply: The notice asks for applications by e-mail or by post, on or before 20 November 2026. It gives these steps:
Prepare a Resume with additional information such as Personal Information in the enclosed format (Annexure-1).
Add the propriety criteria and other declaration as per RBI Circular No.RBI/DoS/2026-27/435/DoS.CO.PPG.29/11.01.005/2026-27.
Super-scribe the position as "Application for the post of Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) in DGM Cadre".

Send the application by e-mail to [email protected], or by post to: Deputy General Manager (HR), Andhra Pradesh Mahesh Co-operative Urban Bank Ltd., Head Office-8-2-680/1&2, Road No.12, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad – 500 034.

Annexure-1, enclosed with the notice, asks for: full name, father's name, date of birth and age, place of birth, nationality, permanent address, address for communication, telephone numbers, an alternative contact number with the relation of the contact person, e-mail ID, PAN, Aadhar No., and disciplinary proceedings faced, if any, during the entire service. It then asks for educational and professional qualifications beginning with SSC or equivalent (examination passed, board/university, year of passing, subjects), professional qualifications, and awards/achievements/appreciation.

For job experience, the form asks for the total number of years and details in reverse chronological order, starting from the latest: post held, period of service (from and to), name of the bank/company, scale (I/II/III/IV/V/VI), roles of duties, last pay drawn, expected CTC and notice period.
Resume with personal information in the Annexure-1 format
Propriety criteria and other declaration as per the RBI circular
Latest three months Salary Pay Slips
important_instructions: The notice invites applications only from candidates who meet the eligibility criteria. The bank's contact numbers printed with the application address are 040-23437100/101/102/103 &105; the letterhead prints Ph.23437103/105/106. Details and eligibility criteria are also available on www.apmahesh.bank.in under the Career page.

content_sections.heading: About AP Mahesh Bank
content_sections.text: Andhra Pradesh Mahesh Co-operative Urban Bank Ltd. describes itself in the notice as a leading Multi State Scheduled Co-operative Bank based at Hyderabad, with a network of 45 branches spread across 4 states: Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Rajasthan. Its Head Office is at 8-2-680/1&2, Road No.12, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad – 500 034, and the recruitment notice is issued by the bank's Deputy General Manager (HR).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate shall be a Graduate/ Post Graduate. The candidate shall have a good understanding of the Banking industry (Urban Co-operative Bank) and Compliance of RBI regulations and guidelines. The candidate shall have knowledge of regulations, legal requirement, audit & inspection functions, and have sensitivity to Supervisory expectations. The candidate must have experience of at least 15 years at the senior management level in the Banking sector. Knowledge of statutory/regulatory prescriptions law, accountancy, risk management, information technology, etc., is desirable. Candidates with MBA/CFA/ICWA/CA/CS/CAIIB will be given preference. Knowledge of regional language may be considered as an advantage. The age limit for the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) in DGM Cadre post is not more than 65 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Under the heading "Propriety Criteria & Deed of Covenants", the notice states that candidates may refer to the 'Fit & Proper' criteria of RBI Circular No.RBI/DoS/2026-27/435/DoS.CO.PPG.29/11.01.005/2026-27 dated July 31, 2026 on Appointment of Chief Compliance Officer in Urban Co-operative Banks for further details. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Commensurate with the Qualification & Experience of the Candidate. The notice does not print a pay scale or amount. Term of Office: The term of the Chief Compliance Officer shall be for a period of three years at a time. Extension: The term may be extended as per extant norms at the discretion of the Management. Cadre: The post is in the DGM Cadre.
